title: Commuters unaffected by PISTON transport strike, Cebu City official says
summary: The Cebu chapter of public transport sector group Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng mga Tsuper at Operator Nationwide joined the organization's call for a nationwide strike on Tuesday.
